slides.texte_overlay:
Things that make a man
hard to replace
He solves problems instead of reporting them. "Here's what went wrong and here's how I fixed it." Every team and every family needs that kind of man.
He stays calm when everyone else panics. A steady voice in a crisis is rare. People remember who kept his head when things went wrong.
He keeps learning skills other people avoid. Cooking, basic repairs, first aid, handling money. Being useful in many situations makes you valuable everywhere.
He makes people around him better. He shares what he knows, gives credit and helps others grow. Men like that are never easy to replace.
He stays curious. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and that small daily habit keeps my mind sharp and my ideas fresh.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. That small daily habit keeps my mind sharp and my ideas fresh.

slides.texte_overlay: He is loyal. To his friends, his partner, his word. Loyalty is getting rarer, which makes it more valuable than ever. Stay loyal, even when it costs you.
He brings good energy. Not fake positivity, just warmth and a sense of humour. People want to keep someone who makes hard days lighter.
